name: Default Agent Failure Rules
description: Common agent-trace anomalies over DProvenanceKit's vendor-neutral event vocabulary (tool_call.*, llm_call.*, agent_invocation.*). These names are produced by `dprovenancekit ingest` (OTel/OTLP traces) and by the live integrations in canonical mode: openai-agents `register(store, canonical=True)`, LangChain `DProvenanceTracer.trace(..., canonical=True)`. Without canonical mode the integrations emit framework-native names (openai-agents `function.*`, LangChain `toolStarted`) that this preset won't match — enable canonical mode, ingest via OTel, or write a preset targeting the native types. Rules whose signal needs data no emitter yet produces (a registered-tool list, a distinct tool-result-vs-reasoning event) are intentionally omitted until the emitters carry it.

rules.message: Runaway tool use: the agent made more than 10 tool calls in a single run.
A tool call completed but was not followed by a model step that could use its result.
